fields.v: Partly (0.5): a short Scope section states the limits of the study (40 synthetic Python projects, file as outdated source, 16 conventions, single unattended run, two agent-model pairs); no threats-to-validity discussion (e.g., author-built projects, LLM judge)
fields.quote: The study covers 40 Python projects in which the instruction file is the outdated source, with 16 kinds of convention, feature tasks completed in a single unattended run, and two agents: Claude Code with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Codex CLI with GPT-6 Sol.
fields.why: The Scope section does state limitations (and the record itself lists them under limitations), so No may be too strict; Partly is a defensible reading.
fields.doubt: O artigo não tem secção de ameaças à validade, mas a secção 8 'Scope' (pág. 11) enumera os limites do estudo, e tu próprio os usas nas limitações. Decide se isso conta como Parcial (0,5) em Q10 ou se manténs Não (0).
